e.title: Finansinspektionen（瑞典金融监管局）：保险监管与金融稳定报告
e.title_en: Finansinspektionen (Swedish Financial Supervisory Authority): insurance supervision and financial stability reporting
e.summary_en: Sweden’s financial supervisor: an insurance section together with published financial stability, consumer-protection and anti-money-laundering reports and sanction decisions

e.summary: 瑞典金融监管机构：设有保险栏目（Insurance）与市场栏目，并发布金融稳定报告、消费者保护报告、反洗钱风险报告与处罚决定
e.body:
**Finansinspektionen（瑞典金融监管局，FI）** 是**瑞典的金融监管机构**，监管**银行、保险公司与金融市场**。本条目与 [[pensionsmyndigheten]]（养老金局）、[[finanssivalvonta]]（芬兰监管局）同属本轮**填补北欧空白**，形成**「瑞典：管理机构 + 监管机构」「芬兰：监管机构」**的组合。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：英文首页 **26.9KB**；⭐ **保险栏目 `/en/insurance/`（23.8KB）** 与 **市场栏目 `/en/markets/`** 实测存在；**出版物**实测可见多类报告与决定——**《Financial stability report》2026 期**（`/en/published/reports/stability-report/2026/financial-stability-and-prepardness-20261/`）、**消费者保护报告**（`/en/published/reports/consumer-protection-on-the-financial-market/…`）、**洗钱与恐怖融资风险报告**（`/en/published/reports/reports/2026/prioritised-risks-related-to-money-laundering-terro…`）、以及**处罚决定**（如对某上市公司会计处理不当的警示）；另实测可见 **AML 定期报送将有大改动** 的新闻（2026）；站内另有 **Applying and reporting** 栏目。

对 RIAA：**① 补上瑞典监管侧**——本轮三条瑞典/芬兰条目合起来给出**「同一国家的不同机构分工」**：**养老金局管给付与预测、监管局管审慎与市场行为**；对照池内既有条目（[[dnb]] 荷兰央行、[[fsca]] 南非行为监管、[[apra-insurance-statistics]] 澳洲审慎、[[acpr]] 法国双业监管），**北欧这一组补的是「小型开放经济体 + 高保险渗透率」的制度样本**。**② 报告体系值得注意**——FI 的**出版物结构把「金融稳定」「消费者保护」「反洗钱」「处罚」并列**，这对做**监管有效性与披露比较**的学生是现成的框架对照；其中**金融稳定报告**与 [[solvency2rfr]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-equity-risk-scr]] 一类偿付能力主题直接相关。**③ 报送（Reporting）栏目**提示**监管数据来自机构定期报送**，与 [[dnb]]「基于监管信息发布统计」的口径一致。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页、保险栏目页、市场栏目页与若干报告/决定的链接**，**但未打开任何报告**，因此**不能确认报告内容与统计口径**；**② 未核实该站是否有保险行业统计数据集**（FI 的统计可能通过瑞典统计局或其他渠道发布，**本次未确认，故不作主张**）；**③** 英文页面体积较小（首页 26.9KB、保险页 23.8KB），**可能少于瑞典语版本内容**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供精算工具。**核实说明**：英文首页（26.9KB）与 `/en/insurance/`（23.8KB）HTTP 200 实测，报告与处罚链接在站内实测可见；**未打开任何报告、未核实是否有保险统计数据集**。
e.body_en:
**Finansinspektionen (FI)** is **Sweden’s financial supervisory authority**, supervising **banks, insurers and financial markets**. With [[pensionsmyndigheten]] (the pensions agency) and [[finanssivalvonta]] (the Finnish supervisor), this entry belongs to this round’s **Nordic gap-filling**, forming a "**Sweden: administration plus supervision**" and "**Finland: supervision**" combination.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the English homepage is **26.9KB**; ⭐ an **insurance section `/en/insurance/` (23.8KB)** and a **markets section `/en/markets/`** were verified; under **published material** several report types and decisions were observed — the **Financial Stability Report, 2026 edition** (`/en/published/reports/stability-report/2026/financial-stability-and-prepardness-20261/`), a **consumer-protection report** (`/en/published/reports/consumer-protection-on-the-financial-market/…`), a **money-laundering and terrorist-financing risk report** (`/en/published/reports/reports/2026/prioritised-risks-related-to-money-laundering-terro…`) and **sanction decisions** (e.g. a caution to a listed company over accounting), plus a 2026 news item that **periodic AML reporting is changing materially**; the site also has an **Applying and reporting** section.

For RIAA: **① it adds the Swedish supervisory side** — the three Swedish/Finnish entries this round together show **how one country divides the work**: **the pensions agency handles benefits and projections, the supervisor handles prudential and conduct matters**; against existing entries ([[dnb]] the Dutch central bank, [[fsca]] South Africa’s conduct regulator, [[apra-insurance-statistics]] Australian prudential data, [[acpr]] France’s combined banking-and-insurance supervisor), **the Nordic group adds the "small open economy with high insurance penetration" sample**. **② The reporting framework deserves note** — FI lists **financial stability, consumer protection, anti-money-laundering and sanctions side by side**, a ready-made framework for comparing **supervisory effectiveness and disclosure**; the **financial stability report** connects directly to solvency topics such as [[solvency2rfr]], [[ggsolvencyii]] and [[sii-equity-risk-scr]]. **③ The Reporting section** signals that **supervisory data arrives through periodic institution reporting**, consistent with [[dnb]]’s "statistics from supervisory information".

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage, the insurance and markets section pages and links to several reports and decisions**, **but opened no report**, so **their content and statistical definitions cannot be confirmed**; **② it was not verified whether the site publishes insurance-industry statistics** (FI’s statistics may be released via Statistics Sweden or another channel — **not confirmed, so no claim is made**); **③** the English pages are small (homepage 26.9KB, insurance page 23.8KB), **possibly carrying less than the Swedish versions**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers actuarial tools**. **Verification note**: the English homepage (26.9KB) and `/en/insurance/` (23.8KB) were measured at HTTP 200, and the report and sanction links were observed on the site; **no report was opened and the existence of an insurance statistics dataset was not verified**.
e.body_hk:
**Finansinspektionen（瑞典金融監管局，FI）** 是**瑞典的金融監管機構**。本條目與 [[pensionsmyndigheten]]、[[finanssivalvonta]] 同屬本輪**填補北歐空白**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：英文首頁 **26.9KB**；⭐ **保險欄目 `/en/insurance/`（23.8KB）** 與**市場欄目**實測存在；**出版物**實測可見**《金融穩定報告》2026 期**、**消費者保護報告**、**洗錢與恐怖融資風險報告**、**處罰決定**，以及 2026 年**反洗錢定期報送重大變動**新聞；另有 **Applying and reporting** 欄目。

對 RIAA：**① 補上瑞典監管側**——本輪三條合起來展示**「同一國家的不同機構分工」**（**養老金局管給付與預測、監管局管審慎與市場行為**），與 [[dnb]]、[[fsca]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[acpr]] 對照，補上**「小型開放經濟體 + 高保險滲透率」**樣本；**② 報告體系值得注意**——**金融穩定／消費者保護／反洗錢／處罰並列**，是**監管有效性與披露比較**的現成框架；金融穩定報告與 [[solvency2rfr]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-equity-risk-scr]] 直接相關；**③ 報送欄目**提示監管數據來自信機構定期報送，與 [[dnb]] 口徑一致。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁、保險與市場欄目頁及若干報告／決定鏈接**，**但未打開任何報告**；**② 未核實該站是否有保險行業統計數據集（故不作主張）**；**③** 英文頁面體積較小，**可能少於瑞典語版本**；**④** 本詞條**不主張**該站提供精算工具。**核實說明**：兩頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開任何報告**。
